articles.title: Husband remits Rs 80L to seller for wife's property, she gets notice; what ITAT said
articles.summary: According to the I-T department’s ‘Insight Portal’, the woman purchased an immovable property worth Rs 1.4 crore during the financial year that ended on March 31, 2016. The portal monitors high-value financial transactions to help detect instances of tax non-payment.

articles.title: Semiconductor boom may add 1 lakh jobs; senior engineers earn 6x IT salar
articles.summary: Industry experts estimate over 1 lakh jobs in the next three years through the country’s efforts to build a semiconductor ecosystem of its own.

articles.title: Ruchir Sharma warns investors against buying the dip in Taiwan, South Korea
articles.summary: Sharma cautioned that investing in South Korea and Taiwan was essentially another way of betting on the AI cycle in the United States

articles.title: India, Egypt to explore possible trade pact with focus on farmers, fishermen
Raghuram Rajan questions India Inc: 'Why is India's private sector not more ambitious?'
articles.summary: Private investment has remained weak for years despite India's economic potential. Why have technology giants such as TCS and Infosys missed the initial wave of the artificial intelligence revolution? asks Rajan

articles.title: Indian Railways now has freight corridors, but will cargo from road come back?
articles.summary: At first glance, rail freight appears to be thriving. Freight loading has risen from 1,098 million tonne in fiscal 2015 to 1,617 million tonne in fiscal 2025 and a record 1,670 million tonne last fiscal.

articles.title: Gold falls to Rs 1.36 lakh, silver down 5% on MCX this week; what’s the outlook?
articles.summary: Gold price outlook: Market participants will watch inflation data from India, the US, the UK, the Eurozone and Japan. The minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting, remarks by Federal Reserve officials and US employment figures will also be closely monitored.

articles.title: Noel Tata questions execution of Tata Group's mega projects amid tussle with Chandrasekaran
articles.summary: The Tata Group has committed billions of dollars to semiconductors, aviation, electronics and electric vehicle batteries under Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran, who has led Tata Sons since 2017

articles.title: Sebi plans AI guardrails for capital markets, stresses human oversight in critical decisions
articles.summary: Sebi plans to issue guidelines focusing on the responsible use of artificial intelligence in capital markets. The guidelines will emphasize investor protection, accountability, and the necessity of human oversight in AI decision-making.

articles.title: Tata Steel eyes NINL merger this fiscal; Rs 40,000 crore expansion awaits clearance
articles.summary: Tata Steel plans to finalize the merger of Neelachal Ispat Nigam Ltd (NINL) this financial year. The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) will review the proposed merger soon. Tata Steel has previously acquired NINL's assets for Rs 12,100 crore to enhance production capacity.

articles.title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang exited company in 2025, stays silent on 'personal matters'
'Learn to live with US tariffs': Raghuram Rajan cautions India despite Trump's midterm defeat
articles.summary: Rajan warns that Trump's tariffs may persist despite Democrats winning the US midterms, saying India should not expect major relief from American trade restrictions

articles.title: Bank holiday for Chhath Puja on Monday? Check state-wise list of closures for November
articles.summary: Chhath Puja celebrations will continue until November 16, resulting in temporary bank closures in areas like Patna and Ranchi.

articles.title: India-Egypt trade has 'sky's the limit' potential, says Goyal; eyes bigger investments
articles.summary: India and Egypt are looking to significantly boost their trade partnership through enhanced cooperation and investment. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal highlighted the need for greater movement of goods and services.

articles.title: Bad air, bigger bills: Air pollution drives health insurance claims up fourfold in 3 years
articles.summary: In India, the demand for health insurance claims related to pollution has skyrocketed, witnessing a remarkable fourfold increase in just three years. Notably, working professionals between the ages of 31 and 55 constitute a significant 59% of these claims.

articles.title: ‘Solid but unremarkable’: Goldman Sachs sees global GDP growth at 2.8% in 2027
articles.summary: Global economic growth is projected at 2.8% in 2027, driven by declining energy prices and increased AI investments. Major economies like the United States and Japan are expected to surpass growth estimates.

articles.title: AI losing its shine? Why global investors could turn to India for their next big bet
articles.summary: Investors are questioning the sustainability of returns from heavy AI investments by US companies. This scrutiny may prompt fund managers to consider Indian equities as an attractive investment alternative.

articles.title: India's life insurance sector set for 13-18% annual growth in premiums through FY29
articles.summary: India's life insurance sector is expected to maintain healthy growth supported by increasing demand for protection products. Private life insurers are anticipated to see an annualised premium equivalent compound annual growth rate ranging from 13-18%.

articles.title: 'Handshake' deals could fall: Musk flags risks for Nvidia after Jensen Huang's exit
articles.summary: Elon Musk has voiced his apprehensions regarding Nvidia's supply chain deals in the wake of Jensen Huang's recent resignation. He pointed out that numerous agreements stemmed from personal connections instead of solid contracts.

articles.title: US diesel prices retreat, fall below $6 per gallon for first time in two months
articles.summary: US diesel prices have dropped below $6 per gallon for the first time in two months. This decline comes after prices surged to an all-time high in September due to global supply issues.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Azim Premji: 'Private sector cannot substitute the role of the government in primary education'
articles.summary: Often referred to as the "Czar of the Indian IT Industry," he is best known for transforming Wipro Limited from a small family-run cooking oil business into a multi-billion-dollar global software and outsourcing giant.

articles.title: Indian-origin CEOs lead $15 trillion corporate empire: How much of that success benefits India?
articles.summary: Companies led by Indian-origin business leaders generate $2.5 trillion in annual revenue and employ 5.3 million people worldwide. Hurun India's Anas Rahman Junaid says India must convert this global corporate influence into domestic investment, research and high-value employment.

articles.title: 29 kmpl mileage, ₹1.5 lakh savings? Renault Duster's new deal has a catch
articles.summary: Renault Duster gets benefits of up to ₹1.5 lakh in November 2026. Explore its claimed 29 kmpl hybrid mileage, ₹10.49 lakh starting price, exchange offers and discount conditions.

articles.title: Strong economy drives NH toll to record Rs 6,640 crore in October
Listing will change Tata way, put profit above philanthropy: Noel
articles.summary: Noel Tata has expressed strong opposition to the potential listing of Tata Sons on public markets. He believes such a move may compromise the group's long-standing commitment to philanthropy over profit.

articles.title: Indians ditch gold for gemstones as sales jump 40%; stones cost Rs 5 lakh
articles.summary: The growing preference for premium coloured gemstones as against gold is also translating into higher prices. Paraiba tourmalines, among the rarest gemstones, sell for around Rs 5 lakh per carat in India.

articles.title: Sold commercial units & bought 2 flats, taxman denies Rs 2.5 crore relief on one - what ITAT said
articles.summary: A man sold six commercial units in Mumbai and the sales generated long-term capital gains of around Rs 5 crore. He claimed a deduction of the same amount under Section 54F after investing in residential property.

articles.title: Gold imports account for half of India's $10 billion trade deficit surge: here's why
articles.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to $40 billion in October, with higher gold imports accounting for half the monthly increase.

articles.title: CCPA fines Ola ₹10 lakh over pre-ride tipping prompts, calls practice misleading and unfair
articles.summary: The consumer watchdog has directed Ola to discontinue its pre-ride tipping feature, saying it misled passengers about their chances of securing rides. The regulator found that the payment prompts constituted an unfair trade practice and a dark pattern.

articles.title: 'My worry is that listing will change the Tata way': Noel Tata fears profit over philanthropy
articles.summary: Tata Trusts Chairman Noel N Tata on Saturday said that a public listing could fundamentally alter the group's philosophy, potentially placing shareholder profits ahead of philanthropy. He said the Trusts would work with regulators to protect the Tata way of doing business.

articles.title: India's $40 billion trade deficit raises concerns, but Axis Bank sees limited pressure on rupee. Here's why
articles.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to $40 billion in October, raising concerns about pressure on the rupee. However, Axis Bank Research believes strong services earnings, returning foreign investments and easing oil prices could help contain external risks.

articles.title: Blackstone-backed AirTrunk plans ₹1.03 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh for two data centre campuses
articles.summary: The company has submitted a detailed project report to the Andhra Pradesh government for the proposed facilities, which would have a combined capacity of up to 1.8 gigawatts (GW), according to an emailed statement from AirTrunk.

articles.title: What made India’s net power capacity addition fall to its lowest in a year?
articles.summary: India's net capacity addition fell 37%. Fossil fuel-based capacity additions slowed, with solar and coal additions falling, while gas and diesel capacity declined due to retirements.

articles.title: YES Bank moves Supreme Court for review of ₹8,415 crore AT1 bond ruling
articles.summary: YES Bank has approached the Supreme Court seeking a review of its October 15 judgment overturning the write-down of ₹8,415 crore worth of Additional Tier-1 (AT1) bonds.

articles.title: Tata Group friction spills into operating firms as Voltas chairman pick bypasses Chandrasekaran’s nod
articles.summary: The development follows Noel Tata stepping down as chairman of several boards, including Voltas, earlier this week upon turning 70, the superannuation age for non-executive directors of the group.

articles.title: Tata Trusts vice chairmen hit back at Darius Khambata over Tata Sons listing, governance: Report
articles.summary: The clash follows Khambata’s November 2 letter to Trusts chairman Noel Tata, which faulted Tata Sons' engagement with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), opposed the holding company's proposed listing, and questioned trustee independence.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Elon Musk: 'It's OK to have your eggs in one basket as long as you control what happens to that basket'
articles.summary: Elon Musk is a prominent billionaire entrepreneur, engineer, and tech mogul best known for founding and leading groundbreaking companies in space exploration, electric vehicles, and artificial intelligence.

articles.title: ₹18.90 lakh Mahindra SUV at ₹51 lakh in UK? Three Indian EVs bring a price surprise
articles.summary: Mahindra plans to bring BE 6, XEV 9e and BE 07 electric SUVs to the UK. Explore estimated prices up to ₹65 lakh, claimed 708 km range, features and possible 2027 launch.

articles.title: 'Even Mannat was beyond our means': Shah Rukh Khan reveals his biggest dream in life
articles.summary: Shah Rukh Khan recalls buying his first home with Gauri, revealing even Mannat was beyond their means. Explore his emotional journey and the ₹50 crore Dubai penthouse launch.

articles.title: ‘They’re all coming up into good shape’: Sunil Bharti Mittal talks about succession, brings up sons, daughter, nephews
articles.summary: Sunil Bharti Mittal spoke of his sons, Sharvin and Kavin, his daughter Eiesha Bharti Pasricha, and his nephews, Zubin and Ramit from his brothers Rajan Bharti Mittal and Rakesh Bharti Mittal, and how the succession plan is shaping up.
